Graphics
To install: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen
D-pad: move · A: bomb · X: ability · START: play / pause
Fan-made tribute to Bomberman · Not affiliated with Konami.

Settings

Game feel

Reduce motion turns off slow-mo, zoom, pop-in text and speech bubbles.

Sound

Everything is synthesised, no audio files. Auto picks the music from the theme and mode. The voice reads the announcer banners, so keep Announcer on. Press N in game to mute.

Accessibility & feedback

Offline

Saves every file (3D, portraits) so the game works without a connection. Updates are downloaded in the background too.
Teams need 4 players (P1 + P3 vs P2 + P4). Online: your settings apply when you host. Survival is 1-4 humans against waves of enemies (no bots to pick, no rounds: the score is the waves survived). King of the Hill and Hot Potato are played against bots.
Room code
    P1: pureTV controller or keypad. P2: press Space for WASD, or join with a gamepad.

      Public rooms

        Daily challenge

        A new challenge every day at 00:00 UTC, the same for everybody. Tries are free: only your best score counts. A streak is consecutive days with a finished try.

        Replays

          Your last 10 finished matches are kept on this device. A replay is just inputs, so a link or a .kaboom file replays the exact match anywhere.

          How to play

          1. ✥Move around the arena. Soft bricks can be blown up, grey walls cannot.
          2. 💣Drop bombs: they explode after 2.5 s in a cross. Trap your rivals, then get out of the way.
          3. ★Grab power-ups hidden in the bricks:
            1. ☠Last one standing wins. After 90 s the arena closes in (sudden death).
            Floor tiles and events (optional)
            • Ice you keep sliding
            • Belts arrows push you, bombs and items
            • Pads stand still on one to jump to its twin
            • Spikes dark, then yellow warning, then red: deadly
            • Chaos bomb rain, item rain, quake, swap and frenzy are announced 1.5 s ahead
            Special bombs and abilities (optional, in Settings)
              • Glove, Punch bomb key: on a bomb it throws it 3 tiles, facing a bomb it knocks it 2 tiles. Both fly over blocks
              • Ice bomb freezes for 2 s instead of killing, but a normal blast still kills a frozen player
              • Mine nearly invisible to rivals, goes off 0.5 s after one steps next to it
              • Abilities second key, with a cooldown ring in the bottom bar. Each colour has its own; in story mode every fighter uses a signature move
              Game modes
              • Hill stand alone in the 3x3 zone to score: 30 points wins
              • Potato the holder explodes when the fuse ends: touch someone to pass it
              • Survival enemy waves with red rings: last as long as you can
              Replays and daily challenge
              • Replays every finished match is saved on this device (last 10). Watch it again in any graphics mode, pause, seek, speed up. Share a link or a .kaboom file
              • Daily one challenge a day at 00:00 UTC, same seed for everyone. Tries are free, your best score and streak are kept here, and you can share a score card
              Controls
              • P1 pureTV D-pad moves, A drops a bomb, X uses an ability, START pauses. Use the keypad: 8/2/4/6 move, 1 bomb, 7 ability, 5 START.
              • Second local player Press Space to join the local lobby. Use WASD to move, Space to drop a bomb and E to use an ability.
              • Gamepad D-pad or stick, any button drops a bomb, Start pauses. With abilities on, X is the ability button
              • Touch left pad to move, 💣 to drop a bomb, ⚡ for the ability (only with abilities on)
              • Ability E or Left Shift (P1), Right Shift or 0 (P2). In first person it uses the direction you last walked
              • Pause P or Esc
              • Sound N mutes or unmutes (settings: effects, music style, voice)
              • First person Graphics: Bomber Shooter. ←/→ turn, ↑/↓ walk, , and . strafe, M minimap. In local games only the first player gets this view.
              • DLSS 6 Graphics: DLSS 6. T toggles it, G or the RTX settings button opens the fake control panel. Parody, not affiliated with NVIDIA.
              • Note Bomber Shooter is a nod to the boomer shooter genre. Original art, not affiliated with id Software.
